messages.subject: Account data access
messages.body:
Hello,

I'd like to know who has accessed my account data and for what purpose. I've been a customer for a few years now and I think I'm entitled to know how my information is being used.

Could you send me the details?

Mikko Rantanen

messages.subject: Re: Account data access
messages.body:
Hi Mikko,

I've received your request and passed it on to the team that handles these matters. We'll come back to you once we have the information together.

Hanna-Kaisa Louhi
Rental Coordinator

messages.subject: Re: Account data access
messages.body:
Also, separate question - I'm thinking about renting a plate compactor. Do you deliver to Oulu or is it pickup only?

Mikko
